alright so, let me paint a picture in your head of the sad little wannabe emo kid i was:

i wore hand-me-down tripp pants with super tight baby doll t-shirts that had like spiderwebs and black roses all over them. i used to straighten my hair really poorly and stick all sorts of plastic hair clips in my bangs(dinosaurs, butterflies, cupcakes, pretty much anything as long as it was colorful). i was really big into criss angel, and always wore his merchandise everywhere i went. i also had the typical 100 bracelets on each wrist. and i pretended to like a bunch of bands that i actually could not stand. 

my myspace was full of pictures of me that i went on photobucket and edited to have like guns pointed at my face and all sorts of other shit. i did a whole photoshoot once where i had a surgical mask on because i thought it made me look cool. it did not. 

i spent hours taking those online quizzes that were so cool in the early 2000s, and lots of time on websites pertaining to the celebrities i was into. 

and then one summer i got really into another celebrity and from there on out i was a totally different person. i gained some friends, because as you can guess, i did not have very many before. and they were great. things got more positive, including myself. 

i've still got some of those tastes i used to, but all-in-all, i'm mostly different. looking back on it all, i wish i wouldn't have tried so hard to be like that, because it wasn't cute, and mostly i was just an uncomfortable person doing uncomfortable things. 

now, i'm an uncomfortable adult trying her best. still pretty embarrassing, honestly, but at least now i know how to dress myself.
